fields.description: The Eden is a one- and two-bedroom apartment tower within Sobha Central on Sheikh Zayed Road. Its setting combines landscaped podium space with planned internal links to shopping, leisure and everyday services.

overview: The cited one-bedroom Type A has a compact suite and balcony. Two-bedroom variants differ in orientation and outdoor area, including the larger Type G. Buyers should compare a specific drawing rather than applying a single average to all homes.
research.locationNote: Within Sobha Central on Sheikh Zayed Road. The planned internal circulation connects residential and community uses; confirm actual delivery, tower access and the selected home’s orientation.
research.priceNote: Sobha advertises AED 1.71m subject to inventory. Older portal launch guides and selected resale prices differ; they do not establish the current price or availability of any particular unit.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder presents two versions: 60% during construction/40% handover, and 20% launch down payment/40% construction/40% handover. The displayed stages use its explicit booking option. Obtain the dated current developer calendar and fees before relying on either.
research.handoverNote: The official brochure prints anticipated completion in December 2029. A broker attributes June 2030 to the wider Phase I regulatory record, without primary verification here. These references are distinct; request the unit’s current contractual delivery date.
unresolved: No current unit inventory, signed instalment schedule, parking allocation or service-charge rate retrieved.
Developer anticipated completion and a secondary wider-project register date differ; neither is a guarantee of a unit’s move-in date.
Community retail, clinic, cinema and road links require delivery/access confirmation. Plans allow amendments and furnishings are illustrative.
